content_metadata.description: A video guide to astronomical events in October 2015, presented by Jared Head.

qAndA.question: What is the approximate distance of the Hyades star cluster from Earth?
Which galaxy is the furthest object visible with the naked eye, according to the video?
Which three planets are aligning in the early morning sky during October 2015?

qAndA.answer: Getting up early in the morning.
qAndA.question: What is the hardest part of seeing the planetary alignment, as mentioned in the video?

qAndA.answer: Become patrons on their Patreon campaign to support the creation of more Space Pods.
qAndA.question: What does Jared Head encourage viewers to do at the end of the video besides engaging with the content?

TMRO's Chief Astronomer Jared Head takes a look at a few far off objects in the sky for October 2015.

TMRO Space Pods are crowd funded shows. If you like this episode consider contributing to help us to continue to improve.
